## 正文
````text
name: Arch package and session

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'packaging/arch/**'
      - '.github/workflows/arch-package.yml*'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  arch-package:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container: archlinux:base-devel
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - name: Install build and display test dependencies
        run: pacman -Syu --noconfirm --needed git rust pkgconf python bubblewrap wayland libxkbcommon libxkbcommon-x11 libx11 libglvnd mesa ttf-dejavu xorg-server-xvfb xorg-xauth xdotool
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Build and install
        run: |
          useradd --create-home yohaku-builder
          chown -R yohaku-builder "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
          cd packaging/arch
          runuser -u yohaku-builder -- env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 makepkg --cleanbuild --noconfirm
          pacman -U --noconfirm ./*.pkg.tar.zst
      - name: Verify the installed package and its editable session rule
        run: runuser -u yohaku-builder -- xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1600x1000x24' /usr/bin/python3 -B packaging/arch/verify-session.py
````

## 输出与关联
```yaml
output: ".github/workflows/arch-package.yml"
```
